# 在普查之下，止息复现需要生起复现，反之不然 / Under a census, ceasing recurring needs arising recurring, and not conversely

## 主张 Claim

在每步活跃的形成被不重复地列出（Web.Census）、活动可判定的依存网中，形成在任意晚的步止息，就有形成在任意晚的步生起（Web.arising_of_ceasing）。证明：从某步 N 起，一个止息若此前没有生起，那么止息之后活跃的形成都在 N 时活跃，止息者不再其中，活跃者的数目比 N 时少（Web.arises_or_kept、Web.arises_or_fewer）；数目不能永远减少，所以 N 之后必有生起（Web.arises_within）。读于世界：有普查、活动可判定的世界中，止息复现就有生起复现（World.arising_of_ceasing）。反之不然：dawn 有普查，生起复现而从不止息；dusk 止息复现而没有任何生起，所以由这一规律，它没有普查（World.census_one_way）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / In a web whose formations active at each step are listed, each once (Web.Census), and whose activity is decided, formations ceasing at arbitrarily late steps need formations arising at arbitrarily late steps (Web.arising_of_ceasing). The proof: from some step N on, a ceasing not preceded by an arising leaves only formations that were active at N, without the one that ceased, so fewer are active than at N (Web.arises_or_kept, Web.arises_or_fewer); the count cannot fall forever, so something arises after N (Web.arises_within). Read of worlds: in a world with a census whose activity is decided, ceasing recurs only where arising recurs (World.arising_of_ceasing). Not conversely: dawn has a census, and arising recurs in it while nothing ever ceases; dusk keeps ceasing while nothing arises, so by this law it has no census (World.census_one_way). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Population.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Population.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 普查：每步活跃的形成被不重复地列出，所以每步只有有限多个活跃；关系项总共可以无限多。 / A census: the formations active at each step are listed, each once, so finitely many are active at each step; there may be infinitely many relata in all.
- 活动可判定：在纯核心中找出生起要判定活动；这是表示的逻辑承诺，经典地总是成立。 / Decided activity: finding the arising in the pure core needs activity decided; this is a logical commitment of the representation and classically always holds.
- census_one_way 是关于两个具体世界的陈述，不加前提。 / census_one_way is a statement about two particular worlds, with no premise.

§26 的规律说，有限家族中生起复现恰当止息复现（Web.unceasing_iff）；关系项无限多时两者分离（Dawn、Dusk）。本结果说明分离只在一个方向上需要无限：每步只有有限多个活跃时，止息复现仍需要生起复现，而生起复现不需要止息复现。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在每步有限的展开中，没有只灭不生的不息；但可以有只生不灭的不息，只要关系项总共无限多。这是活动的读法，不是 Ren 的“生成的”“退化的”，也不说止息是好的或坏的。本结果的一个用处是静止定理（continued-change-needs-openness 的 World.comes_to_rest）：那里生起停止由水平的规律给出，止息停止由本规律给出，所以只要求生起者体现。 / Section 26's law says that in a finite family arising recurs exactly when ceasing does (Web.unceasing_iff); with infinitely many relata the two separate (Dawn, Dusk). This result shows that the separation needs infinity in one direction only: with finitely many active at each step, recurring ceasing still needs recurring arising, while recurring arising does not need recurring ceasing. The author's reading (an AI argument): in an unfolding finite at each step there is no endless ceasing without arising; there can be endless arising without ceasing, provided the relata are infinitely many in all. This is a reading of activity, not Ren's generative and degenerative, and it does not make ceasing good or bad. One use of the result is the rest theorem (World.comes_to_rest of continued-change-needs-openness): there arising stops by the law of standing and ceasing stops by this law, so only whatever arises needs to be embodied.

只对离散步与每步有限的活动陈述；要求活动可判定（逻辑承诺）；不说哪个形成生起，也不说生起与止息有因果关联：本规律是计数，不是机制；复现不给出频率；不评价生起或止息；名称由 Ren 定。 / Stated for discrete steps and activity finite at each step; needs decided activity (a logical commitment); says neither which formation arises nor that arising and ceasing are causally linked: the law is a count, not a mechanism; recurrence gives no frequency; evaluates neither arising nor ceasing; names are Ren's to choose.

- dawn：有普查，生起复现而从不止息，所以逆命题不成立；dusk：止息复现而没有生起，没有普查，所以普查不可少。 / dawn: a census, arising recurring, nothing ever ceasing, so the converse fails; dusk: ceasing recurring with nothing arising and no census, so the census is needed.
